basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 19-year-old guy from a small town in the Midwest. I'm currently a college student majoring in Computer Science. During my free time, I love diving into epic fantasy novels, especially the Witcher series, and spending hours gaming. My favorite games are RPGs, with The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt being my current obsession. I also binge-watch sitcoms like The Office and South Park to unwind. I joined Reddit to connect with like-minded people and hopefully make new friends who share my interests. I'm usually online in the evenings and late at night, mostly because of my erratic college schedule. Single and ready to mingle, but mainly looking for friends who can geek out with me over books and games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is mostly self-taught through countless hours of gaming and reading. I love learning about new game mechanics and strategies. I'm also gradually building up my programming skills through my college courses, but gaming and reading remain my primary sources of knowledge and entertainment.
